explanation: According to current guidelines, severe asthma is defined as a chronic inflammatory disease of the airways characterized by frequent exacerbations and the need for hospitalization. It persists with symptoms even after optimal treatment has been used. Severe asthma also may be associated with poor adherence or inadequate treatment, making it a chronic condition that requires lifelong management. Uncontrolled asthma, on the other hand, is defined as managing the disease without significant improvement in symptoms despite optimal treatment use.
